posts.cooked:
Let's all talk about phobias! :D My mom's afraid of sharks thanks to Jaws. The mention about Pete being afraid of them made me want to chime in.

Me, I used to be afraid of heights, but I've since adjusted it into a fear of falling. I'm okay up high so long as I feel safe, on stable ground!

I am also majorly afraid of spiders, but I've been gradually decreasing that over the course of my life. I no longer freak out the instant I see one. Tarantulas don't bother me, and I'm no longer afraid of jumping spiders. All the other ones can get out, though. <.< They're rude.

Other less interesting fears include the depths of the ocean and infinite things. And probably failure.

dpt:

So… what are the Forbidden Topics? It sounds spoookyyy…

(And they gave some clues. Anybody have a very old question that has not been answered?)

Oh, for sure. I bet lots of people do. If we wanted, we could go do question searches and compare notes.

It’s fascinating… they’ve had plenty of letters that they read on-air, but then gave answers like “time will tell” or “I’m sure that doesn’t matter, no, nuh-uh” or even a blunt “we’re not going to talk about that.” I wonder what makes a topic so “forbidden” that they won’t even acknowledge that somebody asked about it?

My first thought is that it’s not about hiding plot points so much as it is the same legalistic thing that led to the policy of not allowing fan-created game content on this forum. Though since they explicitly create stuff from fan suggestions sometimes on the podcast nowadays, I don’t know where any of those lines would be.

At the very least, we can be excited about the tease of plot twists coming out in future games!

posts.cooked:
Legacy has a fear of not measuring up to his family’s example. Young Legacy has a fear of being overshadowed and consumed by her family’s example, ergo Felecia Fields. The latter is probably not a real phobia, but it is the thing Miss Information would probably play on.

They invented Mister Jitters for this episode, but they kinda didn’t have to, because they’d already had Mister Hideous, who had fear gas originally.

Girl Legacy is awful, but Legacy Girl wouldn’t have been bad.

I wonder if Tony Taurus as a kid might have been captured by the cult of gloom, intended as a sacrifice, and gotten away but forever been scared of the occult. And maybe he was brave enough to take on the Organization when they were purely a gang, but then the Operative and then Zhu Long and finally it was too much for him. We know he fought Ashclaw Rivelos, but maybe he then got caught in a web by Perith and she literally slayed his soul, perhaps even without intending to.

They explain why Parse detected Miss Info but Legacy didn’t. Has it ever been explained why Visionary didn’t read Aminia’s mind and casually announce she’s evil? Even with her being Dark Visionary, it would be to her advantage to expose another threat.

A thing the early Expat and Paul stories should have name checked is that none of Amanda’s kills are murders. She’s effectively at war, a literal war against crime.

Legacy has a fear of not measuring up to his family's example.  Young Legacy has a fear of being overshadowed and consumed by her family's example, ergo Felecia Fields.  The latter is probably not a real phobia, but it is the thing Miss Information would probably play on.

They invented Mister Jitters for this episode, but they kinda didn't have to, because they'd already had Mister Hideous, who had fear gas originally.

Girl Legacy is awful, but Legacy Girl wouldn't have been bad.

I wonder if Tony Taurus as a kid might have been captured by the cult of gloom, intended as a sacrifice, and gotten away but forever been scared of the occult.  And maybe he was brave enough to take on the Organization when they were purely a gang, but then the Operative and then Zhu Long and finally it was too much for him.  We know he fought Ashclaw Rivelos, but maybe he then got caught in a web by Perith and she literally slayed his soul, perhaps even without intending to.

They explain why Parse detected Miss Info but Legacy didn't.  Has it ever been explained why Visionary didn't read Aminia's mind and casually announce she's evil?  Even with her being Dark Visionary, it would be to her advantage to expose another threat.

A thing the early Expat and Paul stories should have name checked is that none of Amanda's kills are murders.  She's effectively at war, a literal war against crime.
